text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! You wish to watch Kabuki, my 
favorite art form?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The ticket lottery for the closing 
performance begins tomorrow! If we win, 
let us go watch it together!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyaa!! I didn't get picked in the 
lottery!!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...I wanted to show it to you, Trainer.
